questions.text: What is the most important factor in getting useful output from a generative AI tool?

answers.text: Using the most advanced AI model available
Writing clear, specific, and well-structured prompts
Running the same prompt multiple times and averaging the results
Uploading as many reference documents as possible

questions.text: Which of the following are appropriate uses of AI in a procurement workflow? Select all that apply.

answers.text: Using AI to make the final vendor selection based on proposal scores
Using AI to pre-screen a large volume of vendor submissions for completeness before human review
Using AI to determine best value among competing bids
Using AI to flag invoices that don't match contract terms for human review
Using AI to summarize a lengthy publicly available contract and identify key clauses for a procurement officer to review
Using AI to waive a compliance requirement when a vendor narrowly misses a threshold

questions.text: As AI becomes more integrated into procurement workflows, which of the following skills will become more important for procurement professionals? Select all that apply.

answers.text: Manual data entry and document formatting
Writing effective AI prompts to get reliable, useful outputs
Familiarity with legacy procurement software systems
The ability to write code and configure AI systems independently
Interpreting AI-generated analysis and knowing when to question it
Ensuring fairness and transparency in AI-assisted evaluation processes
Professional judgment and accountability for consequential procurement decisions

questions.text: A procurement officer uses AI to summarize a 200-page vendor contract. The AI returns a summary that looks complete and well-organized. What should the officer do next?

answers.text: Accept the summary as final and move forward
Share the summary directly with legal counsel without further review
Verify the AI's output against the original contract before relying on it
Re-run the prompt with different wording to get a second opinion
